item.text: {"answer":"2415","solution":"By the grid Laplacian product formula, the spanning-tree count is \\(\\frac1{15}\\prod_{(a,b)\\ne(0,0)}(\\lambda_a^{(3)}+\\lambda_b^{(5)})\\), where each path Laplacian contributes its eigenvalues, including zero. For the 3-vertex path the eigenvalues are \\(0,1,3\\). For each \\(c\\in\\{1,3\\}\\), the product over the five-vertex path eigenvalues is \\(\\prod_{b=0}^4(c+\\lambda_b^{(5)})=c\\,p(c)\\), where the supplied polynomial \\(p(x)=\\prod_{b=1}^4(x+\\lambda_b^{(5)})\\). Thus the full nonzero product is \\(p(0)\\cdot 1p(1)\\cdot 3p(3)=5\\cdot 54\\cdot 3\\cdot 320=259200\\). Dividing by 15 gives \\(17280\\).","insight":"The Laplacian eigenvalues of a Cartesian product graph are pairwise sums of the eigenvalues of its factors.","insight_justification":"The grid is the Cartesian product of the 3-vertex and 5-vertex paths, so its Laplacian is the sum of the two path Laplacians acting on separate coordinates; tensor products of their eigenvectors therefore have eigenvalues equal to the corresponding sums."}
